text:
Alina: heads-up — pushing canary for release v2.18 at 2026-05-12T16:00:00Z (UTC). Planned lane: canary -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%. rollout window 20m. Please confirm owners for smoke + rollback readiness.
Marco: I can own smoke for the first 25%. Will watch latency/5xx for 15m.
Riley: I can do the 50% smoke check and verify traces/kv-cache hit rate. What metric thresholds are we using?
Alina: good q — thresholds: 95p latency not up >20% vs baseline, 5xx spike >1.5x baseline, error-rate >0.5% absolute. If any threshold tripped, rollback to v2.17.
Jen: rollback steps: 1) flip feature-flag to opt-out, 2) call infra runbook: `./scripts/rollback.sh v2.17`, 3) notify paging (ops-rotation). I'll be ready to run the script.
ops-rotation: I'm on-call for the window and will handle paging. Make sure runbook link is up-to-date.
Marco: quick check — DB migration? Any schema changes?
Alina: no schema changes for this release. Just a config toggle and model bump (quantized v1->v1.1).
Riley: can we get a smoke checklist in-thread so we don't scramble? I'll paste what I'll run.
Riley: ```
# 50% smoke checklist
- sanity gen test (prompt smoke-suite) x10
- SLOs: p95/p99 latency, 5xx rate check
- trace sample: verify kv cache hits > baseline -5%
- logs: no new stack traces
```
Jen: 👍 I'll verify rollback script logs and monitor deploy-bot events.
deploy-bot: RELEASE SCHEDULED: v2.18 canary scheduled by Alina at 2026-05-12T16:00:00Z. CI: green. Health checks: passing.
Alina: final ask — signoff pls: Marco (25% smoke), Riley (50%), Jen (rollback owner), ops-rotation (on-call). Reply with :thumbsup: when you can take it.
Marco: :thumbsup: — will be watching.
Riley: :thumbsup: — prepared.
Jen: :thumbsup: ready to execute rollback if needed.
ops-rotation: :thumbsup: on-call and paged.
Alina: thanks all. I'll start the canary at the exact time and post updates in this thread. If any quick blockers surface before start (eg: infra throttling), ping me immediately.
Marco: noted. tagging SRE channel too in case we need quota bump.
Riley: saving this checklist to the release doc after deploy.
Alina: deploy started -> moving to 25% now. Posting smoke results in ~10m.
deploy-bot: CANARY: 25% rollout started at 2026-05-12T16:00:15Z.
Marco: initial smoke: gen tests ok, p95 latency +8% (within threshold), 5xx steady. Holding to watch for 10m.
Riley: all good from tracing side so far. kv-cache hit stable.
Alina: proceeding to 50%
deploy-bot: ROLLOUT: 50% initiated at 2026-05-12T16:11:30Z.
Riley: running 50% checklist now...```
